title: Fasting: Training in Sabr and Taqwa
summary: At the age of 7-9, a child can try partial fasting. We focus on understanding the meaning of fasting (sabr, mindfulness of Allah, feeling for the poor) rather than merely abstaining from food.
try_this: In the coming Ramadan: let him fast until Dhuhr (half a day), break your fast together, and discuss: What did you feel when you were hungry?
reflection_prompts: How does your child behave when he feels hunger?
What question did he ask about fasting?
